description: " – The measure directly implements and strongly supports the target by addressing sustainable land management practices, regulating livestock numbers, and promoting sustainable grazing, which are all essential for reducing ecosystem degradation. The reported measure directly implements and strongly supports the NAP policy target by promoting sustainable livestock management practices, regulating livestock numbers, and improving water supply, which are all essential for fostering resilience to climate change. Both the measure and target aim to enhance the sustainable management of pastures and water resources for herders and their communities, aligning their goals and expected outcomes closely.
